purpose: Kida recipe discovery inventory. Only source-backed discoveries belong here; the matrix renders whatever is present rather than filling cells with placeholders.

recipes.title: Grilled Nile Perch / Mbuta
recipes.why: A direct perch-family grill recipe with a simple seasoning profile and low-heat grilling. Good reference when the goal is uncomplicated catch-to-grill cooking.
instructions: Cut cleaned perch into grill-friendly portions and dry the surface.
Season and marinate briefly with the savory mixture.
Grill over controlled, relatively low heat so the fish cooks evenly without drying.
Turn once the first side releases cleanly; finish until opaque and safely cooked.
recipes.note: Kida would keep the seasoning light on fresh Bay perch and avoid overpowering the fish.

recipes.title: Grilled Koi Maach · Chile, Garlic & Lime
recipes.why: Useful for anglers who want a stronger-spiced whole-fish treatment. The chile, garlic and lime profile suits a firmer perch preparation.
instructions: Season the cleaned fish with salt and lime, then coat with the spice mixture.
Grill, turning and basting as needed, until cooked through.
recipes.note: This is a longer marinade than Kida's quick Catch & Cook tier, so it is classified as Dinner.

recipes.title: Perch Fillet with Greens & White Wine
recipes.why: A direct perch recipe that uses a short stovetop cook and a light pan sauce rather than burying the fish.
instructions: Check the fillet carefully for bones and portion it.
Lightly coat the fish and brown it in a pan with oil and butter.
Add the greens and a small amount of broth, cover, and finish gently.
recipes.note: Kida likes this as a dinner preparation when you want more structure than a plain pan sear.

recipes.title: Perch Fish Risotto
recipes.why: A higher-effort use of perch that turns trimmings and fillet pieces into a composed meal.
instructions: Build or warm a light fish stock, ideally using clean fish trim.
Sweat aromatics and toast the rice.
Deglaze with wine and add stock gradually.
Add perch in stages so some flavor integrates while the final pieces stay distinct.
Finish with lemon zest and butter.
recipes.note: This is a Showpiece preparation because the stock and risotto technique take more time and attention.
